'''Kakirk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] Nexus collector who lived in [[Aurilia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kakirk appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
